claim_boundary: This packet prioritizes existing road evidence gaps by canonical route exposure. It does not create road_class_overrides.csv, does not certify source sufficiency, and does not close road, validation, graph-scale, or final-study gates.
remaining_blockers: capacity and disruption evidence still require source-backed or accepted assumption treatment
connector assumptions still require route-plausibility review before route-level claims
result_scope: Road evidence priority packet only; not reviewed road-class overrides, not calibrated traffic evidence, not graph-scale acceptance, not validation acceptance, and not operational routing evidence.
review_items: collect or accept speed, capacity, and disruption evidence for exposed high-priority road classes first
review connector assumptions separately from OSM road-class evidence
use unexposed classes as lower-priority coverage unless graph-scale or route candidates change
regenerate this packet after road-class overrides, route exposure, or graph-scale method changes
